title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
script:
Google just transmitted an AI response from orbit.
The satellite uses on-board Tensor Processing Units to run the Gemma 4 model.
This hardware successfully booted up while circling the planet.
Engineers prompted the model to write a haiku about being in space.
The Gemma 4 model successfully generated that poem from space.
Google posted the results of this test on Friday.
Would you trust an AI operating from orbit with your data?

editor.one_line: Strong, concise reporting, but visual variety is lacking and some frames are held too long.
script_fixes: LINE 3: Change 'This hardware' to 'The TPU hardware' to avoid vague references.
LINE 7: Change 'Would you trust an AI operating from orbit with your data?' to 'Does space-based AI pose a new security risk for your data?' to be more specific.
visual_notes: line 2: The same Google/Gemma logo graphic is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 3: The 'Orbiting hardware' visual is repeated for two consecutive frames.
line 5: The 'Gemma 4' logo graphic is reused, creating visual fatigue.
